classification_definitions.integration: Core assertion materially traverses genuine project service/API/network/process/store/runtime boundary.

classification_definitions.mixed: Independent material local-only and genuine boundary assertion blocks coexist.
classification_definitions.unresolved: Insufficient source/mapping evidence to support the other categories.
